evidence: Prior to growth experiments, Si (111), Si (100), and sapphire substrates were cleaned sequentially using isopropanol, acetone, methanol, and deionized water in an ultrasonic bath. In order to remove the native oxide layer on the substrate surface, additional diluted HF (2%) cleaning process was applied for 2 min. To prepare an enhanced nitridated surface in order to eliminate possible nucleation delays and to enhance the crystalline quality, a nitridation process step was utilized before the ALD cycles by applying 60 s of N2/H2 plasma and subsequently 60 s of N2 plasma.
